description: Jorge Restrepo-Morales publishes a Python replication package examining the timing of electricity supply expansion and data-centre demand. The September 2026 ZIP archive contains a generating-capacity equivalence calculator, plotting code, a CSV of reported quantities and sources, and a DOI-resolution table. The calculator converts annual electricity-demand growth into equivalent generating-unit counts and reports sensitivity to its assumptions. It needs Python 3 without additional dependencies; the separate plotting script needs Matplotlib. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The calculation can provide transparent capacity assumptions for planning simulations, but it does not estimate a demand forecast, site-specific connection queue or power-system dispatch model. One reported quantity is explicitly untraced, and the underlying documentary evidence may age. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this calculator. Code and numerical results were not independently tested.
